structured_output.what_is_happening: KITSU INU is a generic Shiba-style dog meme ("royal Shiba dynasty rising to the Moon Castle") launched on pump.fun about 27 minutes before detection. It is still on the bonding curve at about $28-30k market cap. It rose about 700% in its first half hour on about $25k volume from 127 unique buyers. The team paid for 50 DexScreener boosts, set up a template Netlify site and opened a Telegram channel that has 6 subscribers. One non-creator wallet holds 24.95%. GMGN puts dev/team holdings at 30.8% and top bundler holdings at 33.8%, so that wallet is probably tied to the dev or a bundle.

narrative.description: Generic Shiba Inu / 'Moon Castle dynasty' dog meme. It is not tied to any current cultural, news or internet event.
narrative.why_spreading: Demand seems to come from pump.fun launch flow plus paid DexScreener boosts (50 active). I found no organic mentions on X, Reddit or news.

token_connection.why_this_token: The contract is the one listed on its own site and Telegram. Since there is no outside narrative, nothing makes this the canonical KITSU.
token_connection.competing_tokens: Older KITSU tokens: Kitsu (fox IP memecoin, about $214k mcap), Kitsune Inu, KitsuCoin, KITSURO, plus the kitsuinu.com token-creator brand. None is being traded actively against this one.

authenticity.evidence: 50 paid DexScreener boosts, a 6-subscriber Telegram, a template Netlify site and no web or social footprint. Fresh wallets are 30%, there are 9 bundler wallets, and bundlers hold 33.8% at the top.
authenticity.uncertainty: X was inaccessible (HTTP 402), so any organic X posts are invisible to me.

structural_risks: A single wallet holds 24.95%, which is probably dev/bundle-linked (dev_team_hold_rate 30.8%)
On the bonding curve with about $21k curve depth, so a dump by the 25% holder would crash the price
Paid boost spending is often followed by insider exits

structured_output.counterargument: The curve is at 86.7 of about 115 virtual SOL, so it is fairly close to migrating. 127 unique buyers in 30 minutes and a buy/sell ratio above 1 show real flow. Boosted pump.fun coins sometimes run to $60-100k+ on graduation hype, and a 2x from about $30k only needs about $60k.
unknowns: Whether the dev plans more promotion
